title: One Second on Earth Looks Like This
description: Lightning, newborn babies, and a planet racing around the Sun: everything that happens on Earth in one single second.

scenes.label: 1 second
scenes.text: That is one single second on Earth.
scenes.say: That is one single second on Earth.

scenes.label: around the Sun
scenes.text: In that same second, you flew thirty kilometers around the Sun.
scenes.say: [excited] In that same second, you flew THIRTY kilometers around the Sun.

scenes.label: spun at the equator
scenes.text: If you live near the equator, the ground under you spun almost half a kilometer.
scenes.say: If you live near the equator, the ground under you spun almost half a kilometer.

scenes.label: felt: nothing
scenes.text: And you felt none of it.
scenes.say: [whispers] And you felt none of it.

scenes.label: never stops
scenes.text: The planet never pauses, never slows, never waits for anyone.
scenes.say: The planet never pauses, never slows, never waits for anyone.

scenes.label: again
scenes.text: By the time this sentence ends, it has happened again.
scenes.say: [curious] By the time this sentence ends, it has happened again.

scenes.label: don't blink
scenes.text: So don't blink, because in one blink you just missed...
scenes.say: [chuckles] So don't blink, because in one blink you just missed...
